title: Dua of Imam Husayn (a) on the day of Ashura بِحَقِّ يٰسٓ وَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْحَكِيْمِ
data:
This is the supplicatory prayer the Holy Prophet (s) said on the days of the Battle of Badr and the Battle of the Allies (al-Ahzab). Imam al-Husayn (a), chief of the martyrs, also said this same supplication at Karbala on the day of Ashura. Two further supplications were said by Imam al-Husayn (a) that day; the first is the one he taught his son Imam Zayn al-Abidin (a) as he embraced him to his chest while blood poured from his wounds, for use in urgent need, intense grief, hardship, and difficulty:
بِحَقِّ يٰسٓ وَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْحَكِيْمِ وَ بِحَقِّ طٰهٰ وَ الْقُرْاٰنِ الْعَظِيْمِ
BI-HAQQI YAASEEN WAL QUR-AANIL HAKEEM WA BI-HAQQI TAA-HAA WAL QUR-AANIL A'ZEEM
By the right of Ya-Sin and the Wise Qur'an, and by the right of Ta-Ha and the Great Qur'an,
يَا مَنْ يَقْدِرُ عَلٰى حَوَاۤئِجِ السَّاۤئِلِيْنَ يَا مَنْ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى الضَّمِيْرِ
YAA MAY YAQDIRU A'LAA HAWAAA-IJIS SAAA-ILEENA YAA MAY YA'LAMU MAA FID DAMEER
O He Who has power over the needs of those who ask, O He Who knows what is in the innermost heart,
يَا مُنَفِّسًا عَنِ الْمَكْرُوْبِيْنَ يَا مُفَرِّجًا عَنِ الْمَغْمُوْمِيْنَ
YAA MUNAFFISAN A'NIL MAKROOBEENA YAA MUFARRIJAN A'NIL MAGHMOOMEEN
O He Who relieves the distressed, O He Who removes the grief of the grieved,
يَا رَاحِمَ الشَّيْخِ الْكَبِيْرِ يَا رَازِقَ الطِّفْلِ الصَّغِيْرِ
YAA RAAHIMASH SHAYKHIL KABEERI YAA RAAZIQAT TIFLIS SAGHEER
O He Who has mercy on the elderly, O He Who sustains the young child,
يَا مَنْ لَايَحْتَاجُ اِلَى التَّفْسِيْرِ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
YAA MAL LAA YAHTAAJU ILAT TAFSEER SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD
O He Who needs no explanation, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
وَافْعَلْ بِىْ كَذَا وَ كَذَا
WAF-A'L BEE KAZAA WA KAZAA
and do with me such-and-such (mention your need).
One may then submit his requests.
Fifth: Imam al-Sadiq (a) is reported to have raised his hands towards the sky and said:
رَبِّ لَاتَكِلْنِىْۤ اِلٰى نَفْسِىْ طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ اَبَدًا لَا اَقَلَّ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا اَكْثَرَ
RABBI LAA TAKILNEE ILAA NAFSEE TARFATA A'YNIN ABADAL LAA AQALLA MIN ZAALIKA WA LAA AKTHAR
My Lord, do not entrust me to myself even for the blink of an eye, ever — neither less than that nor more.
Sixth: Imam al-Sadiq (a) is also reported to have advised saying:
اِرْحَمْنِىْ مِمَّا لَاطَاقَةَ لِىْ بِهِ وَلَاصَبْرَ لِىْ عَلَيْهِ
IRHAMNEE MIMMAA LAA TAAQATA LEE BIHI WA LAA SABRA LEE A'LAYH
Have mercy on me from that which I have no strength to bear and no patience for.
Seventh: Imam al-Sadiq (a) is also reported to have advised saying:
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنّىْۤ اَسْئَلُكَ بِجَلَالِكَ وَ جَمَالِكَ وَ كَرَمِكَ اَنْ تَفْعَلَ بِىْ كَذَا وَ كَذَا
ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALUKA BI-JALAALIKA WA JAMAALIKA WA KARAMIKA AN TAF-A'LA BEE KAZAA WA KAZAA
O Allah, I ask You by Your majesty, Your beauty, and Your generosity, to do with me such-and-such.
One may then submit his requests.
Eighth: Fazl ibn Yunus reports that Imam al-Kazim (a) advised him to repeat this supplication frequently:
اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْنِىْ مِنَ الْمُعَارِيْنَ وَ لَا تُخْرِجْنِىْ مِنَ التَّقْصِيْرِ
ALLAAHUMMA LAA TAJ-A'LNEE MINAL MU-A'AREENA WA LAA TUKHRIJNEE MINAT TAQSEER
O Allah, do not count me among those whose faith is only lent, and do not exempt me from feeling my shortcoming.
The first statement asks not to be counted among those whose faith is as unsettled as a loan, not firmly fixed in the heart, or among those left entirely to themselves with no reliance on Allah. The second asks not to be counted among those who feel they have discharged their duty to their Lord perfectly — one should always feel one's efforts fall short of that duty, however much is exerted.
Ninth: Imam al-Baqir (a) said that Almighty Allah forgave a Bedouin for two words he said in his supplication:
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنْ تُعَذِّبْنِىْ فَاَهْلٌ لِذٰلِكَ اَنَا وَ اِنْ تَغْفِرْلِىْ فَاَهْلٌ لِذٰلِكَ اَنْتَ
ALLAAHUMMA IN TU-A'ZZIBNEE FA-AHLUL LI-ZAALIKA ANAA WA IN TAGHFIRLEE FA-AHLUL LI-ZAALIKA ANT
O Allah, if You punish me, I deserve it; and if You forgive me, You are worthy of that.
Tenth: Dawud al-Raqqi said that whenever he pressed his request in prayer, Imam al-Sadiq (a) would ask Almighty Allah in the name of the Five Persons: the Holy Prophet, Imam Ali, Lady Fatimah, Imam al-Hasan, and Imam al-Husayn, peace be upon them.
Eleventh: Yazid al-Sa'igh said: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a) to pray for our good, so he said:
اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْهُمْ صِدْقَ الْحَدِيْثِ وَ اٰدَاۤءَ الْاَمَانَةِ وَ الْمُحَافَظَةَ عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ
ALLAAHUMMAR ZUQHUM SIDQAL HADEETHI WA ADAAA-AL AMAANATI WAL MUHAAFAZATA A'LAS SALAWAAT
O Allah, grant them truthfulness in speech, the fulfilling of trusts, and the safeguarding of their prayers,
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّهُمْ اَحَقُّ خَلْقِكَ اَنْ تَفْعَلَهُ بِهِمْ اَللّٰهُمَّ افْعَلْهُ بِهِمْ
ALLAAHUMMA INNAHUM AHAQQU KHALQIKA AN TAF-A'LAHU BIHIM ALLAAHUMMAF-A'LHU BIHIM
O Allah, they are the most deserving of Your creatures for You to do this for; O Allah, do it for them.
Twelfth: say this supplication, which Imam Ali, Amir al-Mu'minin (a), used to say:
اَللّٰهُمَّ مُنَّ عَلَىَّ بِالتَّوَكُّلِ عَلَيْكَ وَالتَّفْوِيْضِ اِلَيْكَ وَالرِّضَا بِقَدَرِكَ وَ التَّسْلِيْمِ لِاَمْرِكَ
ALLAAHUMMA MUNNA A'LAYYA BIT TAWAKKULI A'LAYKA WAT TAFWEEDI ILAYKA WAR RIDAA BI-QADARIKA WAT TASLEEMI LI-AMRIK
O Allah, favor me with reliance upon You, entrusting my affairs to You, contentment with Your decree, and submission to Your command,
حَتّٰى لَاۤ اُحِبَّ تَعْجِيْلَ مَاۤ اَخَّرْتَ وَ لَاتَاْخِيْرَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
HATTAA LAA UHIBBA TA'JEELA MAA AKHKHARTA WA LAA TA-KHEERA MAA A'JJALTA YAA RABBAL A'ALAMEEN
so that I do not wish to hasten what You have delayed, nor to delay what You have hastened, O Lord of the worlds.
Thirteenth: it is reported that the Angel Gabriel came to the Holy Prophet (s) with this message from Almighty Allah: if you want to worship Me a whole night and day perfectly, raise your hands towards Me and say:
اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا خَالِدًا مَعَ خُلُوْدِكَ
ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAN KHAALIDAM MA-A' KHULOODIK
O Allah, to You is praise, everlasting praise along with Your everlastingness,
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا لَا مُنْتَهٰى لَهُ دُوْنَ عِلْمِكَ
WA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAL LAA MUNTAHAA LAHU DOONA I'LMIK
and to You is praise, praise with no limit short of Your knowledge,
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا لَاۤ اَمَدَ لَهُ دُوْنَ مَشِيَّتِكَ
WA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAL LAA AMADA LAHU DOONA MASHEE-ATIK
and to You is praise, praise with no bound short of Your will,
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا لَاجَزَاۤءَ لِقَاۤئِلِهِ اِلَّا رِضَاكَ
WA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAL LAA JAZAAA-A LI-QAAA-ILIHI ILLAA RIDAAK
and to You is praise, praise whose speaker's only reward is Your good pleasure.
اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كُلُّهُ وَ لَكَ الْمَنُّ كُلُّهُ وَ لَكَ الْفَخْرُ كُلُّهُ
ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU KULLUHU WA LAKAL MANNU KULLUHU WA LAKAL FAKHRU KULLUH
O Allah, to You belongs all praise, to You belongs all favor, to You belongs all pride,
وَ لَكَ الْبَهَاۤءُ كُلُّهُ وَلَكَ النُّوْرُ كُلُّهُ وَ لَكَ الْعِزَّةُ كُلُّهَا
WA LAKAL BAHAAA-O KULLUHU WA LAKAN NOORU KULLUHU WA LAKAL I'ZZATU KULLUHAA
to You belongs all splendor, to You belongs all light, to You belongs all might,
وَ لَكَ الْجَبَرُوْتُ كُلُّهَا وَ لَكَ الْعَظَمَةُ كُلُّهَا
WA LAKAL JABAROOTU KULLUHAA WA LAKAL A'ZAMATU KULLUHAA
to You belongs all sovereignty, to You belongs all greatness,
وَ لَكَ الدُّنْيَا كُلُّهَا وَ لَكَ الْاٰخِرَةُ كُلُّهَا
WA LAKAD DUNYAA KULLUHAA WA LAKAL AAKHIRATU KULLUHAA
to You belongs all of this world, to You belongs all of the Hereafter,
وَ لَكَ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ كُلُّهُ وَ لَكَ الْخَلْقُ كُلُّهُ
WA LAKAL LAYLU WAN NAHAARU KULLUHU WA LAKAL KHALQU KULLUH
to You belongs the night and the day in their entirety, to You belongs all creation,
وَ بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ وَ اِلَيْكَ يَرْجِعُ الْاَمْرُ كُلُّهُ عَلَانِيَتُهُ وَ سِرُّهُ
WA BI-YADIKAL KHAYRU KULLUHU WA ILAYKA YARJI-U'L AMRU KULLUHU A'LAANIYATUHU WA SIRRUH
and in Your hand is all good; and to You all affairs return, their open and their hidden.
اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا اَبَدًا اَنْتَ حَسَنُ الْبَلَاۤءِ جَلِيْلُ الثَّنَاۤءِ
ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAN ABADAN ANTA HASANUL BALAAA-I JALEELUTH THANAAA-I
O Allah, to You is praise, everlasting praise; You are beautiful in trial, glorious in acclaim,
سَابِغُ النَّعْمَاۤءِ عَدْلُ الْقَضَاۤءِ جَزِيْلُ الْعَطَاۤءِ حَسَنُ الْاٰلَاۤءِ
SAABIGHUN NA'MAAA-I A'DLUL QADAAA-I JAZEELUL A'TAAA-I HASANUL AALAAA-I
abundant in favor, just in decree, generous in giving, beautiful in bestowals,
اِلٰهٌ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَ اِلٰهٌ فِى السَّمَاۤءِ
ILAAHUN FIL ARDI WA ILAAHUN FIS SAMAAA-I
God in the earth and God in the heaven.
اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِى السَّبْعِ الشِّدَادِ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِى الْاَرْضِ الْمِهَادِ
ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU FIS SAB-I'SH SHIDAADI WA LAKAL HAMDU FIL ARDIL MIHAAD
O Allah, to You is praise in the seven firm heavens, and to You is praise in the outspread earth,
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ طَاقَةَ الْعِبَادِ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ سَعَةَ الْبِلَادِ
WA LAKAL HAMDU TAAQATAL I'BAADI WA LAKAL HAMDU SA-A'TAL BILAAD
and to You is praise to the utmost of Your servants' capacity, and to You is praise as vast as the lands,
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِى الْجِبَالِ الْاَوْتَادِ
WA LAKAL HAMDU FIL JIBAALIL AWTAAD
and to You is praise amid the mountains, the pegs of the earth,
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِى اللَّيْلِ اِذَا يَغْشٰى وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِى النَّهَارِ اِذَا تَجَلّٰى
WA LAKAL HAMDU FIL LAYLI IZAA YAGHSHAA WA LAKAL HAMDU FIN NAHAARI IZAA TAJALLAA
to You is praise in the night when it covers, and to You is praise in the day when it shines forth,
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِى الْاٰخِرَةِ وَ الْاُوْلٰى
WA LAKAL HAMDU FIL AAKHIRATI WAL OOLAA
and to You is praise in the Last Life and the First,
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِى الْمَثَانِىْ وَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْعَظِيْمِ
WA LAKAL HAMDU FIL MATHAANEE WAL QUR-AANIL A'ZEEM
and to You is praise in the oft-repeated verses and the Great Qur'an,
وَ سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْاَرْضُ جَمِيْعًا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ وَالسَّمٰوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌ بِيَمِيْنِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَ تَعَالٰى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ
WA SUBHAANAL LAAHI WA BI-HAMDIHI WAL ARDU JAMEE-A'N QABDATUHU YAWMAL QIYAAMATI WAS SAMAAWAATU MATWIYYAATUM BI-YAMEENIHI SUBHAANAHU WA TA-A'ALAA A'MMAA YUSHRIKOON
And glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him — the whole earth shall be in His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens shall be folded in His right hand; glory be to Him, exalted above what they associate with Him,
سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَ بِحَمْدِهِ كُلُّ شَيْئٍ هَالِكٌ اِلَّا وَجْهَهُ
SUBHAANAL LAAHI WA BI-HAMDIHI KULLU SHAY-IN HAALIKUN ILLAA WAJHAH
glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him — everything is perishing except His Countenance,
سُبْحَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَ تَعَالَيْتَ وَ تَبَارَكْتَ وَ تَقَدَّسْتَ
SUBHAANAKA RABBANAA WA TA-A'ALAYTA WA TABAARAKTA WA TAQADDAST
glory be to You, our Lord; exalted, blessed, and holy are You.
خَلَقْتَ كُلَّ شَيْئٍ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَ قَهَرْتَ كُلَّ شَيْئٍ بِعِزَّتِكَ
KHALAQTA KULLA SHAY-IM BI-QUDRATIKA WA QAHARTA KULLA SHAY-IM BI-I'ZZATIK
You created everything by Your power, and You subdued everything by Your might,
وَ عَلَوْتَ فَوْقَ كُلِّ شَيْئٍ بِارْتِفَاعِكَ وَ غَلَبْتَ كُلَّ شَيْئٍ بِقُوَّتِكَ
WA A'LAWTA FAWQA KULLI SHAY-IM BI-IRTIFAA-I'KA WA GHALABTA KULLA SHAY-IM BI-QUWWATIK
and You rose above everything in Your loftiness, and You overpowered everything by Your strength,
وَ ابْتَدَعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْئٍ بِحِكْمَتِكَ وَ عِلْمِكَ
WABTADA'TA KULLA SHAY-IM BI-HIKMATIKA WA I'LMIK
and You originated everything by Your wisdom and knowledge,
وَ بَعَثْتَ الرُّسُلَ بِكُتُبِكَ وَ هَدَيْتَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ بِاِذْنِكَ
WA BA-A'THTAR RUSULA BI-KUTUBIKA WA HADAYTAS SAALIHEENA BI-IZNIK
and You sent the messengers with Your books, and You guided the righteous by Your permission,
وَ اَيَّدْتَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ بِنَصْرِكَ وَ قَهَرْتَ الْخَلْقَ بِسُلْطَانِكَ
WA AYYADTAL MU'MINEENA BI-NASRIKA WA QAHARTAL KHALQA BI-SULTAANIK
and You strengthened the believers with Your aid, and You subdued creation by Your dominion.
لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ
LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA WAHDAKA LAA SHAREEKA LAK
There is no god but You, alone, with no partner unto You;
لَا نَعْبُدُ غَيْرَكَ وَلَانَسْئَلُ اِلَّاۤ اِيَّاكَ وَلَانَرْغَبُ اِلَّاۤ اِلَيْكَ
LAA NA'BUDU GHAYRAKA WA LAA NAS-ALU ILLAA IYYAAKA WA LAA NARGHABU ILLAA ILAYK
we worship none but You, we ask none but You, and we desire none but You;
اَنْتَ مَوْضِعُ شَكْوَانَا وَ مُنْتَهٰى رَغْبَتِنَا وَ اِلٰهُنَا وَ مَلِيْكُنَا
ANTA MAWDI-U' SHAKWAANAA WA MUNTAHAA RAGHBATINAA WA ILAAHUNAA WA MALEEKUNAA
You are the place of our complaint, the utmost of our desire, our God, and our King.
(The record of this thirteenth supplication in this app's history ends here; it is traditionally reported to continue at greater length.)
